ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark pigment covering >95% of the surface, with localized high-intensity (light-grey to white) pixels restricted to specific scar sites and abrasions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous solid dark-grey pigmentation across the visible span, punctuated by discrete, high-contrast circular ring-shaped clusters and thin linear streaks mapping primarily to the mid-lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with a measured central angle of approximately 35 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending roughly 10% of the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary with high-frequency peaks and valleys (amplitude 5-15 pixels) across the longitudinal extent of both trailing edges, isolated from the high-intensity background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges of the lobes follow a generally convex curve from the median notch toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially discrete circular ring clusters (diameter 15-30 pixels) visible on both lobes; notably a vertical alignment of three rings near the right side of the notch and several clusters on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single prominent, high-intensity near-vertical linear disruption (approximately 160 pixels in length) visible on the left lobe, crossing the dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring indicative of barnacle attachment sites and a distinct vertical linear mark on the inner left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe tip shows a jagged, irregular distal termination compared to the relatively smoother taper of the left lobe tip.
